caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a light brown finish, featuring a straight seat and a backrest composed of vertical spindles connecting to a horizontal top rail. The bench has two armrests, each skillfully shaped into a spiral or scroll form at the ends. Four legs support the bench; the front legs are straight while the back legs angle outward, and additional horizontal crossbars connect the legs for structural support. The overall composition centers the bench against an off-white or beige background, bordered by a thin, light red line that frames the drawing within the rectangular paper. The wood grain detail is evident throughout the drawing, emphasizing the construction and natural material.
title: Settee
